title: Where does the licence payment come from?
teach: v1 has no wallet, so a licence payment is recorded purely as a burn: B rises, S_max falls, and no branch ledger is debited to pay for it. This fixture pins that documented rule — it fails if the Cockpit is ever changed to settle licences out of accrued ledger instead.

actions.note: let c-0001 accrue some ledger first
